newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-INJURED KANISHCHEV OUT FOR RUSSIA'S CYPRUS GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED KANISHCHEV OUT FOR RUSSIA'S CYPRUS GAME.

text.p: Russian striker Anatoly Kanishchev will miss Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Cyprus due to injury, a Russian official said on Thursday.
Lokomotiv Moscow midfielder Yevgeny Kharlachev and Spartak Moscow's top-scoring winger Andrei Tikhonov are also injured and will miss the group five game.
Sporting Gijon's Yuri Nikiforov is out after being sent off in Russia's previous game in Luxembourg.
Russia, with two wins and a draw, lead the group ahead of Israel.
Goalkeepers - Stanislav Cherchesov (Tirol Innsbruck), Sergei Ovchinnikov (Lokomotiv Moscow)

Defenders - Ramiz Mamedov (Spartak Moscow), Dmitry Khlestov (Spartak Moscow), Omar Tetradze (Roma), Igor Chugaynov (Lokomotiv Moscow), Maxim Bokov (CSKA Moscow), Dmitry Popov (Compostela), Viktor Onopko (Oviedo)
Midfielders - Igor Yanovsky (Alania), Andrei Kanchelskis (Fiorentina), Dmitry Alenichev (Spartak Moscow), Ilya Tsymbalar (Spartak Moscow), Alexander Mostovoy (Celta Vigo), Valery Karpin (Valencia)
Forwards - Igor Kolyvanov (Bologna), Igor Simutenkov (Reggiana), Alexei Gerasimenko (Rostselmash Rostov).
